name: 24179 · Vinton, VA
findings: ZIP 24179 (Vinton) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 24179 (Vinton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 24179 (Vinton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
